newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin to annnounce Russian gvt line-up on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin to annnounce Russian gvt line-up on Monday.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin will annnounce his decisions on the membership and structure of the new Russian government on Monday, a presidential spokesman said.
"Some of the decrees will be published today, some of them may come tomorrow," the spokesman said.

Yeltsin met Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin and his fIrst deputy Anatoly Chubais in the Kremlin on Monday. A Kremlin press release said Yeltsin had approved the government structure proposed by Chernomyrdin.
"The main candidates for key government posts have also been considered (deputy prime ministers and some ministers)," the press statement said.
"It is expected that B.Yeltsin will sign a number of corresponding decrees today."

Earlier on Monday Yeltsin offered the post of another first deputy prime minister to the reformist governor of the Nizhny Novgorod region, Boris Nemtsov, who had agreed to work alongside Chubais, the Kremlin said.
